decisions.reason: The final sentence incorrectly inferred symmetry of an arbitrary force model from kinematic covariance. For N=1, I0=R, Q=R^3, m>0 and the smooth force F(t,x,w)=-kappa w with kappa>0 of dimension mass/time, x(t)=0 solves m x''=F. Under the admitted boost y(t)=x(t)+u t with u nonzero, m y''=0 but F(t,y,y')=-kappa u is nonzero. Clause (vi) of post-cm02-force-superposition instead transforms the law to F_*(t,y,w)=-kappa(w-u), which admits the boosted curve. Thus covariance requires transferring the force law and does not establish symmetry of the fixed law. The repaired paragraph states this distinction and defines the additional invariance requirement.
